en.title: Sea Breeze and the Amber Table
en.premise: Exhausted by life in the city, Himari flees back to her hometown. There, she finds solace in the quiet meals prepared by her grandmother and a mysterious star chart left behind by her grandfather, a former lighthouse keeper. As family memories unfold through the simple act of cooking, her frozen heart begins to slowly thaw. This is a story of discovering that the time she thought was lost has actually been right there all along, as comforting as a warm meal.

zh.title: 海风与琥珀色的餐桌
zh.premise: 厌倦了都市生活，阳葵仿佛在逃避一般回到了故乡。在那里，她遇见了祖母经营的宁静餐桌，以及曾任灯塔守护者的祖父留下的神秘星图。随着日常料理逐渐揭开家族的记忆，她那颗冰封已久的心也开始慢慢融化。这是一个关于发现的故事：那些她以为已经失去的时间，其实一直都在那里，如同温暖的料理一般，始终陪伴在侧。
